summary: Design secure CI/CD controls, review SBOMs, and manage dependency risk. Explore this advanced DevSecOps course and plan your training.
lede: DevSecOps and software supply chain security training helps DevOps engineers, software architects, and security teams secure CI/CD pipelines. It covers mapping pipeline threats, assessing dependencies and software bills of materials, and positioning automated security tests and release gates. Participants also review infrastructure-as-code risks and create a practical blueprint for applying controls within their delivery workflow.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for professionals who build, secure, operate, or govern software delivery pipelines and need to turn security expectations into workable CI/CD controls.
prerequisites: Prior experience operating or securing software delivery workflows is expected. You should be familiar with Git, CI/CD concepts, containers, and infrastructure as code; basic YAML and command-line familiarity will help with exercises. Programming is not required to complete the course, and exercises focus on reviewing configurations and outputs rather than building production systems.
